invocations.selection: lr per (dataset, input, trunk, width) by final val_acc of seed 0; the other seeds run at that lr only; test reported, never used for selection

metrics_legend.lr_end: one-cycle learning rate after the epoch's last step
metrics_legend.train_loss: mean cross-entropy over the epoch's training batches (dropout on), nats
metrics_legend.train_acc: fraction of training inputs classified correctly during the epoch (dropout on)
metrics_legend.val_loss / val_acc: cross-entropy (nats) / accuracy on the 5k held-out val split, eval mode
metrics_legend.epoch_s: wall-clock seconds for the epoch including the val pass
metrics_legend.summary final_{train,val,test}_acc: accuracy of the head after the last epoch, eval mode; test is computed once, at the end, and never used for selection
